final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS overall_avg_remaining_gb FROM step1) SELECT step1.site_code, step1.insurance_status, step1.avg_remaining_gb, step1.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, step1.avg_remaining_gb / step2.overall_avg_remaining_gb AS ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
